prompt:
Write complete game/src/render.js for PORT DELMAR: LOW TIDE, an original polished 2D canvas coastal open world crime game. OUTPUT FILE IMMEDIATELY, brief reasoning, about230 lines compact JS. Only a javascript code block. No libraries/network/assets. Imports {CITY,CAR,COLORS} from './config.js'. CITY width2560 height2240 block320 road88 coast2240. COLORS ink#112d3b paper#fff0cc mint#7ff1c5 coral#ff765f gold#ffcd61 water#227e91.
Exact export createRenderer(canvas) returns {draw(state),screenToWorld(x,y,state),buttons:[]} mutable buttons array of {id,x,y,w,h} logical1280x720 used by main to hit test mouse. Canvas resizes backing store to window size max DPR2, draws logical1280x720 stretched to viewport, pointer coords already logical. screenToWorld uses state.camera transform with center640,360. Camera {x,y,zoom} zoom e.g.1.0.
State {world,player:{x,y,angle,health,ammo},car:null|carReference,camera,screen:'title'|'play'|'paused'|'help'|'busted'|'wasted'|'complete',elapsed,money,best,completed:[],mission:0,stage:0,objective,marker:null|{x,y,label},dialogue:string,toast:string,wanted:integer0..5,escape:number,bust:number,muted:boolean,hasSave:boolean,particles:[],bullets:[]}.
World {width,height,time,roads:[{x,y,w,h,axis:'h'|'v'}],buildings:[{x,y,w,h,color,roof,name,height}],parks:[{x,y,w,h}],trees:[{x,y,r}],props:[{x,y,type,angle}],cars:[{id,x,y,angle,speed,health,color,kind:'civilian'|'police',parked,controlled}],peds:[{x,y,angle,health,panic,color,cop?}],pickups:[{x,y,type:'health'|'ammo',active}],lights:[{x,y,phase}]}. Time continuous seconds. Bullets {x,y}; particles {x,y,life,color}. Roads centered x/y=160+320n; horizontal up to2240. Buildings sit between roads. All data can be assumed exact.
Function list internal: resize,text,rect,drawCity,drawBuilding,drawCar,drawPerson,drawPalm,drawHud,drawMinimap,drawMenus,button,draw. Render sun-soaked warm coastal city with generous detail: teal ocean x2390+ with wave strokes, golden sand2240..2390 with umbrellas, sidewalks cream around road surfaces slate gray, dashed lanes and zebra crossings, traffic signal red/green, pastel roofs with shaded offset building sides, rooftop HVAC and window rhythm, parks grass and paths, palm trees as dark shadows and several curved fronds, car directional shapes rotated to angle (front along local+x) with shadows black tires dark windows head/tail lights police red/blue strobes, people circles with limbs shadows and aiming pistol for player. Player peach/white jacket dark pants; cop navy. Draw marker pulsing gold rings and vertical diamond with label, direction arrow at edge when offscreen. Draw bullets and particles. Cull buildings/trees by camera viewport to perform well. World text street labels on road Pelican Avenue, Calle Sol, Seabreeze Boulevard with subtle typography. Tiny district labels.
HUD: top left PORT DELMAR / LOW TIDE in small uppercase; top right $money, 5 wanted stars filled gold empty translucent, 24hour clock from 16:40+elapsed*0.1; health and ammo bottom left above minimap; speed km/h and car integrity bottom right when driving. Mission objective panel centered top below header, dialogue box lower center, contextual E enter/exit and controls bottom. Minimap bottom left at x26,y495,w190,h190 world overview roads buildings coast, player arrow, tiny traffic and redblue police dots, amber mission marker. Escape bar when wanted plus SEARCHING / IN SIGHT. Premium graphic look crisp canvas UI ivory/mint/orange on dark navy, no generic gradients everywhere.
TITLE: still show rich city backdrop on right two thirds, dark translucent left panel width560 with editorial typography huge PORT / DELMAR, LOW TIDE small gold strapline, intro text 'The harbor is being sold. Mara has a ledger. / You have a borrowed set of keys. / Make a living. Decide who owns this city.' Buttons x60 y460 Start(id start), y516 Continue(id continue; show even without save label 'Continue / no save yet' but main handles), y572 How to Play(id help). Bottom original canvas art / offline. A decorative top right region tag '27° N / THE WATERFRONT'. Make cover beautiful. Title must not hide all city.
Other menus centered dark panel; paused buttons resume/save/title; help controls with back; busted/wasted restart/title; complete 'MISSION COMPLETE' +toast reward and next button. Menu buttons clickable keyboard selection main handles. draw resets buttons each frame. Make usable at1280x720. Do not call input/audio/game logic. Complete file now.
